from numpy import array


def affiche(f, nl):
    f = open("resultat.txt", "r")
    for i in range(nl):
        ch = f.readline()  # lire_ligne(f,ch)
        print(ch)
    f.close()


def nombre_ligne(f):
    nl = 0
    ch = f.readline()
    while ch != "":
        nl = nl + 1
        ch = f.readline()
    return nl
    f.close()


def remplir(m, nl, nc, f):
    f = open("Source.txt", "r")
    for i in range(nl):
        ch = f.readline()  # 67 115 4 23 88 99.............
        ch = ch + " "
        for j in range(nc):
            p = ch.find(" ")  # p <-- pos(" ",ch)
            ch1 = ch[:p]
            ch = ch[p + 1:]
            m[i, j] = int(ch1)
    return m
    f.close()


def generer(m, nc, i):
    ch = ""
    for j in range(nc):
        ch = ch + str(m[i, j]) + " "
    ch = ch[:len(ch) - 1]
    return ch


def former(f2, m, nl, nc):
    for i in range(nl):
        ch = generer(m, nc, i)  # remplir une variable de type chaîne
        f2.write(ch + "\n")  # ecrire dans le fichier    ecire_nl(f,ch)
    f2.close()
    return f2


def former2(f2, m, nl, nc):
    for i in range(nl):
        for j in range(nc):
            f2.write(str(m[i, j]) + " ")  # ecrire
        f2.write("\n")  # ecrire_nl(f2) : retour à la ligne
    f2.close()
    return f2


def trier_colonne(m, nl, j):
    arret = False
    while not arret:
        p = False
        for i in range(0, nl - 1):
            if m[i, j] > m[i + 1, j]:
                x = m[i, j]
                m[i, j] = m[i + 1, j]
                m[i + 1, j] = x
                p = True
        arret = p == False
    return m


def trier(m, nl, nc):
    for j in range(nc):
        m = trier_colonne(m, nl, j)
    return m

# print("nl = ",nl)
